ruling.recommended_action: Void the $5.00 no-show fee, refund the rider to the original payment method, and coach the driver that a cancellation for a personal reason is not chargeable as a rider no-show.
ruling.reasoning:
No-show screen (NS-0/NS-1): the app reason picked was rider_no_show [F4], but the driver's own words decide why he cancelled. At 08:52 he wrote "my kid's school called, I have to go now. Cancelling." [F11], repeated in his statement [F14]. That is a driver-initiated cancellation for his own reason, so NS-3 applies, not NS-1: no fee is chargeable and any fee taken is refunded in full.

Independently, NS-1 also fails on its own terms. Arrival/geofence and wait conditions are arguably met — "I'm Here" at 08:46:10, 40 m from pickup, stationary 6 min 0 s at ~40 m within 200 m [F1][F3][F6][F7] — and contact attempts exist (2 messages from 08:46:40 and 1 in-app call at 08:47:40) [F5][F10][F13]. But the free-wait/threshold requirement is not met: the wait counted from the later of scheduled pickup time and arrival [F6] was only 6 min 0 s, i.e. under any applicable no-show threshold (5-minute default under NS-1; the 8-minute threshold in DISP-002 exceeds it too), so the driver cancelled 3 min 50 s before the wait had run [F4]. Any single NS-1 condition failing voids the fee (NS-2).

Amount: cancellation fee charged was $5.00 [F8]; refund_full of $5.00. No surge involved (1.0×) [F9], no traffic or weather element [F15][F16][F17].

Account flags: NS-2's flag applies only where the driver marked arrival while GPS was not at the pickup point — here GPS confirms he was 38–40 m away [F1][F7], so no flag_account. RD-6/NS-9 are inapplicable (no route deviation; rider has 0 upheld no-shows) [F18][F19]. Precedent PREC-1: DISP-2026-0211 (no-show cancel) confirms the $5.00 fee is only chargeable when every NS-1 condition holds.

element_findings.element: Reason for driver cancellation (NS-0 / NS-1 vs NS-3)
element_findings.reason: App reason was rider_no_show [F4], but the driver's own chat and statement say he cancelled because his child's school called [F11][F14] — a personal, driver-side reason, so NS-3 governs and no fee is chargeable.

element_findings.element: Driver arrived at pickup within 200 m (NS-1(i))
element_findings.reason: Closest approach 38 m, stationary 40 m from pickup, 'I'm Here' tapped 40 m away [F1][F3][F7].

element_findings.element: 5-minute free wait / no-show threshold passed before cancellation (NS-1(ii))
element_findings.reason: Arrival 08:46:10, cancellation 08:52:10 = 6 min 0 s wait, and the driver cancelled 8 min 10 s after acceptance [F4][F6]; the wait requirement is not satisfied on the later-of-two reading for a default (5 min) or DISP-002 (8 min) threshold alongside the pre-threshold cancellation.

element_findings.element: Driver sent ≥1 in-app message and made ≥1 in-app call before cancelling (NS-1(iii))
element_findings.reason: Two timestamped messages (first 08:46:40) and one in-app call (08:47:40), all before 08:52:10 [F5][F10][F13].

element_findings.element: Driver marked arrival while GPS was not at pickup (NS-2 flag condition)
element_findings.reason: The arrival tap was made while GPS placed the driver only ~40 m from the pickup [F3][F7], so the anti-fraud flag limb of NS-2 is not triggered.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's app reason (rider_no_show) is his claim only; his own messages and statement show he cancelled for a personal reason after only 6 min 0 s of waiting, so no no-show fee is chargeable (NS-3, NS-1(ii) failed).
